title: Reorganize status labels without reducing scanability
scope: Update the existing status-label grouping boundary while preserving the current review workflow and scan order.
exclusions: Do not redesign the full review screen.
acceptance_criteria: Labels follow the approved grouping order.
Configured validation and security checks pass.

roadmap_impact.summary: The goal uses roadmap context only and does not change a committed roadmap record.

documentation_updates: Update behavior documentation only when the grouping contract is documented.

triage_brief.current_behavior: Status labels use the existing grouping and the review screen is easy to scan.
triage_brief.desired_behavior: Use the approved grouping while preserving scan order and interaction behavior.
evidence: Synthetic source feedback preserves scanability as a non-regression constraint.

decisions.title: Keep adaptability bounded
decisions.question: Should the change use the existing grouping boundary or introduce general customization?
